items.title: Stuart Bergen Interview, 1970-07-18
items.q: Oh he was one of my good friends. He practiced with me.

ctx.x: Beautiful tunes too. They're not all jazz tunes. And some of them are like Red Rose Rag. I didn't even hear of it. But still they only played some beautiful tunes. In the old days you had a voice to a tune before you come to the chorus. And let me call you sweetheart. I didn't even know I had a beginning, a voice. And he plays the voice to each one of these waltzes. He used to come over here to practice. Oh he was one of my good friends. He practiced with me. He was a fine old gentleman. We had fun.
